import sys

from defusedxml.minidom import parse

W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"

doc = parse("unpacked/word/document.xml")
body = doc.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "body")[0]


def para_text(p):
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "t"):
        texts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else "")
    return "".join(texts)


# Print full XML of every paragraph that is a headline candidate (uppercase text)
# plus neighbors so we can see the pattern (empties, spacing).
paras = body.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "p")
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    text = para_text(p).strip()
    if text and text == text.upper() and any(c.isalpha() for c in text):
        print(f"===== PARAGRAPH {i} (headline candidate): {text!r} =====")
        print(p.toprettyxml(indent=" "))
        print()

import sys

sys.path.insert(0, ".codex/skills/docx")

from scripts.utilities import XMLEditor

W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"

editor = XMLEditor("unpacked/word/document.xml")
dom = editor.dom


def para_text(p):
    parts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "t"):
        parts.append(t.firstChild.nodeValue if t.firstChild else "")
    return "".join(parts)


body = dom.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "body")[0]
headlines = []
runs_underlined = 0

for p in body.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "p"):
    text = para_text(p).strip()
    # Headline = paragraph with text that is all uppercase and contains letters
    if not text or text != text.upper() or not any(c.isalpha() for c in text):
        continue
    headlines.append(text)
    for r in p.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "r"):
        rprs = r.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "rPr")
        if rprs:
            rpr = rprs[0]
        else:
            rpr = dom.createElementNS(W, "w:rPr")
            r.insertBefore(rpr, r.firstChild)
        if rpr.getElementsByTagNameNS(W, "u"):
            continue
        u = dom.createElementNS(W, "w:u")
        u.setAttributeNS(W, "w:val", "single")
        rpr.appendChild(u)
        runs_underlined += 1

editor.save()

print(f"Headlines underlined: {len(headlines)}")
for h in headlines:
    print(" -", h)
print(f"Runs with underline added: {runs_underlined}")
